description: Generate a prioritized flood timeline report for critical infrastructure assets in Muncie, Indiana. A CSV file named 'assets.csv' has been provided in the Muncie project directory, listing asset names, river stations, and flood threshold elevations. Using the HEC-RAS unsteady simulation results (Muncie.p04.hdf), determine for each asset: whether it floods, the time of flood onset (hours from simulation start), the duration of flooding, and the peak depth above the threshold. Save the results to '/home/ga/Documents/hec_ras_results/flood_timeline.csv'. The output file must include columns: 'Asset_Name', 'Flooded' (True/False), 'Time_of_Onset_Hours', 'Peak_Depth_Above_Threshold_ft', and 'Flood_Duration_Hours', and must be sorted by onset time (earliest first).
